description: Utility functions for managing ACP sessions, including resolving session keys, error handling, and configuration-based TTL calculations.

methods.name: resolveAcpAgentFromSessionKey
methods.description: Resolves an agent ID from a session key, using a fallback if necessary.

methods.name: resolveMissingMetaError
methods.description: Creates an error indicating missing ACP metadata for a session key.

methods.name: resolveAcpSessionResolutionError
methods.description: Generates an error based on the resolution state of an ACP session.

methods.name: requireReadySessionMeta
methods.description: Returns session metadata if the session is ready, otherwise throws an error.

methods.name: normalizeSessionKey
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a session key.

methods.name: canonicalizeAcpSessionKey
methods.description: Generates a canonical session key based on configuration and input.

methods.name: normalizeActorKey
methods.description: Normalizes an actor key to lowercase and trims whitespace.

methods.name: normalizeAcpErrorCode
methods.description: Normalizes an error code string to a known set or defaults to 'ACP_TURN_FAILED'.

methods.name: createUnsupportedControlError
methods.description: Creates an error for unsupported control on a backend.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeIdleTtlMs
methods.description: Calculates TTL in milliseconds from configuration, defaulting to 0 if invalid.

methods.name: hasLegacyAcpIdentityProjection
methods.description: Checks if session metadata has legacy identity projection fields.
